title: Runbook RB-112: Rolling upgrade of parcel-router

headings.text: Runbook RB-112: Rolling upgrade of parcel-router

key_sentences: This runbook describes how to upgrade parcel-router to a new release without interrupting label printing at the depots.
Follow every step in order and record the result in the change ticket.
Print a test label from the Kelby depot console and check that the route code matches the postcode.
Watch the error rate on the routing dashboard for fifteen minutes after the rollout.
If the error rate rises above two percent, roll back immediately with the command below.
Rollback does not revert database migrations, which must be handled together with the release team.

rows: Time allowed to finish in-flight requests

list_items.text: An approved change ticket with a maintenance window of at least 60 minutes.
Access to the ops-bastion host and to the deploy role in the cluster.
The release notes for the target version, including any database migrations.
Open a session on the bastion host and confirm the release that is currently running.
Update the production values file with the new image tag.
Apply the change and follow the rollout until every pod reports ready.
Announce the completion in the operations channel and update the change ticket.

code:
ssh ops-bastion
kubectl -n routing get deploy parcel-router \
  -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'

router:
  image:
    repository: registry.harbourline.example/parcel-router
    tag: "4.18.2"
  rollout:
    maxUnavailable: 1
    drainSeconds: 45
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 768Mi

helm upgrade parcel-router ./charts/parcel-router \
  -n routing -f values/prod.yaml --atomic --timeout 15m
kubectl -n routing rollout status deploy/parcel-router
